easyvillagers_dirty_mark_interval.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapWithCondition on the per-tick setChanged() (setChanged) call of TraderTileentityBase.tickServer, FarmerTileentity.tickServer (ordinal 0), BreederTileentity.tickServer and IronFarmTileentity.tick (Easy Villagers 1.21.1-1.1.49): the call runs only when (game time + an offset from the block position) is a multiple of N (value line, default 20 = COO's, range 1-200; 1 = every tick); every other setChanged of these block entities is untouched. Trade-off, off by default: neighbours hear the idle updates up to N-1 ticks late, and a chunk saved between two marks without any other change keeps the villager age counter (and the iron farm timer) up to N-1 ticks behind. Value: PureConfig.intValue("easyvillagers_dirty_mark_interval", 20, 1, 200). Runtime flag easyvillagersDirtyMarkInterval. Helper bons.furious.patch.easyvillagers_coo49.DirtyMarks.
